gen-gf-tektur-fs-amulya: Expressive stencil-cut letters in Tektur lead with a squared, engineered look, all in one steady width. And Amulya follows in a plain sans with low, contemporary shapes and generous curve gaps, so paragraphs keep moving without fuss.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-chillax: Tektur stands up front, stencil-flat and pipe-cleaner thin, with oversized lowercase. Chillax loosens everything below it, its spaghetti-like line and unfinished curves giving the sans-serif body a relaxed, handwritten drift against that rigid heading.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-plein: Plein keeps a clear channel leading into each round letter, which makes its lowercase feel tidy and dependable. Plein can sit at a comfortable moderate size beneath Tektur, whose heading lines carry no modulation at all and look almost drawn with a ruler.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-roundo: Roundo has geometric, neutral lowercase where each n keeps its arch and stem matched, and the small counters stay open. But Tektur above it is the louder one, with outsized lowercase, so a long read in the sans-serif settles down quickly.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings, a dependable sans-serif with moderate lowercase height. Tektur earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-aclonica: Professional and a bit stretched out, the plain sans Aclonica has a deep midsection and widely spaced letters. Aclonica gives lines a lightly shaded texture, a calm counterweight to Tektur's heading, whose crossbars are as thick as its stems.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-allerta: Every stroke in Tektur is traced at the width of one stylus, with outsized lowercase and open curve terminals. Allerta replies with wide, loose tracking and a prominent x-height, so the sans-serif body feels spacious and unhurried over many lines.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-alumni-sans: Sign-painter stencil meets bracelet curves: Tektur holds its line weight flat, while Alumni Sans adds a mild thick-and-thin rhythm and a wide-open c. Flat against gentle, that is their strongest single quality.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs a tight word texture, with oversized lowercase letters beside small capitals and curves as hefty as a rope's body. Alumni Sans Pinstripe stays approachable as a sans-serif under Tektur's expressive heading, and lines read smoothly down the page.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Tektur draws curves with the heft of a rope's body, while Alumni Sans SC adds a slight pressure shadow, like worn charcoal. That texture split is the pair's strongest single quality.
